name: cmbpick9
caption:
PICK 9 🎮🏀 Mono wiped out the start of his college career. We drafted him ninth anyway.

• Missed the start of his freshman year at South Carolina with mono
• 2025 draft: we take Collin Murray-Boyles at #9
• Jan 11, 2026: 17 points, 15 rebounds, 3 blocks, 3 steals, a first in our history
• Playoffs: 22 points on Cleveland, All-Rookie Second Team
• First 9 games this season: 10.7 PPG, 5.0 RPG, 1.2 SPG

Future All-Star or role player? 👇

beats.head: PICK 9
beats.name: COLLIN
beats.vo: Mono wiped out the start of his college career. Two years later, we drafted Collin Murray-Boyles ninth overall.
beats.dlg: MONO WRECKED HIS START.|2025: WE TAKE HIM AT #9.

beats.head: FIRST EVER
beats.name: COLLIN
beats.vo: As a rookie: seventeen points, fifteen rebounds, three blocks, three steals in one game. Nobody in our history had ever done that.
beats.dlg: 17-15, 3 BLOCKS, 3 STEALS.|A FIRST IN OUR HISTORY.

beats.head: PLAYOFFS
beats.name: COLLIN
beats.vo: In the playoffs he dropped twenty-two on Cleveland. And he made All-Rookie Second Team.

beats.head: THIS SEASON
beats.name: COLLIN
beats.vo: Through nine games this season: ten point seven points and five rebounds. Plus nineteen points and four steals in our win at Milwaukee.
beats.dlg: FIRST 9 GAMES: 10.7 PPG.|19 PTS, 4 STEALS AT MIL.

beats.head: PICK 9
beats.vo: Future All-Star, or role player? Comment below.

facts.claim: Before the 2023-24 season at South Carolina, Murray-Boyles contracted mononucleosis and missed significant time; chosen #9 (ninth overall) in the 2025 NBA draft by Toronto; January 11, 2026: 17 points, 15 rebounds, 3 blocks and 3 steals, first player in Raptors history with those numbers; April 23, 2026: playoff career-high 22 points and 8 rebounds in a 126-104 win over Cleveland; NBA All-Rookie Second Team
